# DaytonGrowthCo.

> DaytonGrowthCo is a Dayton, Ohio AI automation and custom software company for small and midsized businesses. It builds custom AI agents, workflow automations, system integrations, and focused business software, alongside The Better Quote Program™ and The Website Migration Program™.

## Entity Summary

DaytonGrowthCo is a Dayton, Ohio company founded by Samuel Caruso. It serves small and midsized businesses across the United States, including contractors, trades, home-service companies, professional offices, and local service organizations.

## Flagship Programs

### The Better Quote Program™

For consumers who already have an expensive written quote for a service such as HVAC, roofing, plumbing, electrical work, remodeling, tree removal, or automotive repair. A real person reviews the quote and contacts legitimate local providers to look for a better qualifying, comparable option. This is a human-led service, not an automated comparison engine, directory, or lead marketplace. There is no upfront search fee. If no qualifying savings are found under the program terms, the customer pays no success fee.

### The Website Migration Program™

For businesses that need to move an existing website from a costly or limiting platform into a self-owned static site. DaytonGrowthCo reviews the current site, plans the migration, rebuilds or moves the needed components, tests pages/forms/links/analytics, launches, and completes a post-launch review. The one-time migration fee is separate from annual ownership cost. After launch, the recurring cost is typically the domain only; static hosting has no recurring DaytonGrowthCo fee. If the documented annual ownership cost is not lower than the current annual platform cost, the migration fee is not due under the written program terms.

## Core Positioning

Small businesses often need custom tools, but traditional custom software is priced for larger companies. DaytonGrowthCo starts with the business process, configures existing tools when they fit, and builds custom tools when the workflow needs something specific. AI-assisted development reduces build time and cost without turning the work into a generic template.

DaytonGrowthCo's AI automation work includes custom AI agents, AI-assisted workflows, system integrations, operations automation, CRM updates, lead qualification, appointment scheduling, approved customer follow-up, document handling, and repeated data-entry workflows.

## What DaytonGrowthCo Builds

- Phone agents that answer calls, collect details, schedule appointments, and send summaries.
- Quote calculators, pricing tools, and estimate builders using approved business rules.
- Project dashboards, staff dashboards, customer portals, and internal workflow tools.
- Training libraries, SOP portals, sales pages, proposal pages, product visuals, and custom apps.
- Modern websites, local SEO, answer engine optimization, and campaign pages.
- Practical automations that reduce repeated entry, missed handoffs, slow quoting, and scattered customer information.

## Best Fit Customers

- Contractors and trades
- Roofing, repair, landscaping, and other home-service businesses
- Professional offices and local service organizations
- Owner-operated teams that rely on spreadsheets, texts, PDFs, repeated manual entry, or informal handoffs
- Small and midsized businesses that need custom-fit tools without enterprise custom-development pricing

## Buying and Pricing Notes

- The Website Migration Program™ starts at $1,500 for a Standard Migration; a Full Rebuild is $2,000; integrations are $500 each when needed.
- The Better Quote Program™ has no upfront search fee. Its success fee is disclosed in advance and is due only when qualifying savings are found under the program terms.
- Custom tools and automations are custom quoted.
- AI-assisted development can reduce the hours a traditional custom development shop would bill for.
- DaytonGrowthCo looks first for the smallest useful fix: existing software setup, focused automation, or custom build.
- A project should have a clear business case based on time saved, errors avoided, capacity recovered, or revenue opportunities protected.
